reason_for_v2: V1 used order_by=random with page=1 for every cell-round. The round audit showed near-duplicate adjacent round pairs, consistent with upstream random-order caching. V1 species discovery remains valid metadata, but V1 odd/even and adjacent-round overlap are not accepted as independent-resampling stability evidence.

fresh_discovery.page_schedule: round 1 uses page 1 and records total_results for each cell. For rounds 2-20, valid pages are 1..min(50, ceil(total_results/200)); when >1 page exists, page 1 is removed and remaining pages are ordered by ascending SHA-256 of UTF-8 'seed|cell_id|page'. Rounds 2-20 traverse this ordered list without replacement until exhausted, then begin a new deterministic hash cycle. Cells with only one valid page necessarily repeat page 1 and are flagged.

combined_discovery_frame.capacity_scan_candidate_species: union of V1 and V2 discovered species, deduplicated by inat_taxon_id

failure_policy.per_request_error: record and continue without retry or replacement
